points.point: Pinterest pin shows published but its link gives a 404
points.sentence: Published means Blotato recorded a publishing result. It does not establish why the post is absent from a feed or why a platform URL is inaccessible.

points.point: What to check next for the pin
points.sentence: Open Posts > Published and confirm the intended destination.

verdict.reason: This entry covers a post marked published whose platform URL is inaccessible, and it applies to Pinterest; the other Pinterest entries are about failed publishes, boards or blocked URLs.
